title: HR and Recruitment Administrator
description:
An exciting opportunity for an experienced CIPD level 3 HR Recruitment Administrator to join a busy fast paced School HR team in Ascot, Berkshire. The HR Administrator is a key member of the Human Resources team, providing efficient administrative support in a busy, fast-paced environment. As an adaptable and resilient individual with excellent interpersonal skills, you will handle changing priorities calmly while maintaining total accuracy, discretion, and a warm, professional approach.
The successful candidate will:
- CIPD level 3
- Full cycle Recruitment and Candidate Experience
- Up to date with Compliance and Safeguarding
- working knowledge of HR Systems Management and Data
- Experienced in HR Administration and Lifecycle
- Payroll and Remuneration
- Continuing Professional Development (CPD)
- Year round working - This is a full-time, 52-week-per-year position. The postholder will be expected to work across the full calendar year rather than solely during the School's academic terms.

Working closely with the Head of HR and line managers, you will deliver a welcoming experience for candidates and staff. Primary responsibilities include end-to-end recruitment, Safer Recruitment compliance, payroll processing, and managing HR systems.

If you would like more information about this fantastic opportunity please contact Jo ASAP

title: HR Administrator
description:
Job Title: HR Co-Ordinator

Location: Reading
Working Pattern: Fully Office Based

Start Date: ASAP with interviews taking place on Monday afternoon onsite
Duration: Temporary for 6 months

Working Days and Hours: Monday - Friday, 9:00 am - 2:00 pm
Hourly Rate: 15.40 per hour

We are looking for an experienced HR administrator to come and join our clients team on temporary basis for 6 months. You will be taking on multiple duties, working alongside the HR Manager supporting and co-ordinating when required. This is a fantastic opportunity to join a close knit busy team.

Responsibilities include, however are not limited to:
- Manage all HR admin including scanning and organising documentation and contracts
- Assisting with all onboarding of new staff members
- Arranging and co-ordinating interviews with candidates
- Updating spreadsheets

To be considered for this role you must have previous experience working within a busy HR team, ideally between 2 - 3 years. You must have strong attention to detail, be a highly organised individual and be able to hit the ground running immediately.

Huntress Search Ltd acts as a Recruitment Agency in relation to all Permanent roles and as a Recruitment Business in relation to all Temporary roles.

We practice a diverse and inclusive recruitment process that ensures equal opportunity for all we work with, irrespective of race, sexual orientation, mental or physical disability, age or gender. As an organisation, we encourage applications from all backgrounds and will ensure measures are met when required, to allow a fair process throughout.

PLEASE NOTE: We can only consider applications from candidates who have the right to work in the UK.

title: Recruitment Administrator
description:
Recruitment Administrator - Trades & Labour - Reading

28k- 30k per annum DOE + OTE Earnings

Daniel Owen is looking for an ambitious Recruitment Administrator to join our Reading team, an excellent opportunity for someone motivated and driven to start their career in recruitment.

Working within our Trades & Labour division, you will support with the recruitment for a range of roles, building strong relationships with candidates and helping clients secure the talent they need.

Your Impact as an Recruitment Administrator

Candidate Relationships: Not just over the phone, but face to face, you'll identify, develop and maintain candidate relationships.

Talent Sourcing: Seek out skilled individuals with the right qualifications and experience for temporary opportunities within the Trades & Labour sector.

Recruitment Support: Provide recruitment and administrative support, including maintaining databases and candidate profiles.

Temporary Recruitment: Support the team with temporary Trades & Labour recruitment, helping to match high quality candidates to suitable roles.

Recruitment Administration: Use your own organisational skills to support a smooth recruitment process, keeping all candidate records up to date and compliant.

The Ideal Candidate Will Be

A Proven Professional: Whether your background is in recruitment, sales, customer service or another target-driven environment, you know how to build relationships, get results and deliver a high-quality service.

Motivated and Ambitious: You are driven to succeed, keen to develop your recruitment career and excited by the opportunity to influence your earnings with your work.

Excellent Communicator: You're a brilliant communicator, both face-to-face and email, with the confidence to build strong relationships with candidates, clients and colleagues.

Adaptable: You thrive in a fast-paced recruitment environment and can confidently pivot when priorities change.

Organised: You are able to plan, structure, and manage tasks efficiently, staying organised to meet deadlines, support live vacancies and achieve goals.

Career-Focused: You are looking for more than a job; you want a long-term career where you can grow, develop and be in more control of your earnings within a supportive team.

Our Benefits Are Second to None

Top Tier Holiday Allowance: Increasing holiday allowance for the first five years, reaching 28 days, plus your birthday off and an additional day for charitable endeavours.

Health and Wellbeing: Private healthcare through Vitality, contributory pension and life assurance.

Director Incentives: Quarterly lunch incentives and personal treat vouchers.

Loyalty Rewards: Additional holiday entitlement and bonus payments linked to service milestones.

Annual Reward Trips: Multiple company trips throughout the year, with previous destinations including Marbella, Prague and Portugal.

Learning and Growth: Access to the Daniel Owen Academy, featuring a structured 12-week training programme alongside one-to-one coaching and ongoing development.

Financial Well-being Support: Access to professional financial guidance through our partnership with One Financial.

Fast-Track Career Development: Our directors all climbed the ladder from within making progression visible and achievable.

Who Are We?

For over 40 years, Daniel Owen has been a leading specialist recruiter within the built environment, recognised for our honest approach, strong relationships and commitment to developing our people.

We believe recruitment is about people first. We invest heavily in training, reward success and provide the support needed for individuals to build long-term careers. As we continue to grow, there has never been a better time to join our team and make a real impact.

Ready to Take the Next Step?

Apply today to start your recruitment career with Daniel Owen. If you would like a confidential conversation about life at Daniel Owen, please reach out to our Talent Acquisition team.
